statement:
def LocalDivisibilityStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ L N : Size, ∀ R : Finset (Site L N), ∀ v : Hilbert L N,
    (∀ e ∈ incidentBonds R, P e v = 0) →
    ∃ q : SpinorPolynomial L N,
      encode v = (∏ e ∈ incidentBonds R, singlet e) * q ∧ IndependentOn R q
